item.title: Gwyneth Paltrow Is Auctioning Off Some of Her Wardrobe for Charity
item.description: A portion of the proceeds for “Bold Luxury: Gwyneth Paltrow Lexicon of Style & the Archival Edit,” organized by Julien’s Auctions, will be donated to World Central Kitchen.

item.title: 'Traitors' Star Colton Underwood Finally Faces His Dark 'Bachelor' Past
item.description: In 2020, Underwood’s ex, Cassie Randolph, filed a temporary restraining order against him. Now, after a wild season of The Traitors, the romantic lead turned reality villain is finally ready to talk about everything: his gameplay, facing death threats, his mindset during his dark pre-coming-out days, and whether he’s still in touch with Randolph.

item.title: The Truth About Celebrity Styling with Kate Young
item.description: Kate Young doesn’t really like custom dresses or method dressing. But she loves fashion. Here, she tells VF all about the art of celebrity dressing—including its backend deals and its do’s and don’ts

item.title: Why You Should Look Closely at That Photograph of Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor
item.description: Christopher Anderson, who has photographed members of the Trump administration for Vanity Fair, examines the image of the former prince seen around the world.

item.title: Paul McCartney, Unfiltered, Part 2: “Go Back and Look at Who Wrote the Hits”
item.description: In the second half of his lengthy 2015 conversation with Joe Hagan, McCartney opens up about reconciling with John Lennon, helping Lennon and Yoko Ono reconcile after a breakup, and his ex-bandmate’s sexuality: “I’d slept with John very often, but there was never anything.”

item.title: Vivian Wilson, Estranged Daughter of Elon Musk, Walks For Gucci at Milan Fashion Week 2026
item.description: Wilson, the eldest living child of billionaire Elon Musk, has been estranged from—and vocally critical of—her biological father since 2020.

item.title: Mike Huckabee, Trump’s Ambassador to Israel, Defends His “Kind Of Strange” Interview With Tucker Carlson
item.description: In a wide-ranging interview with Vanity Fair, the US ambassador to Israel explained his controversial comments to Tucker Carlson and addressed a shift in public opinion against Israel over its bloody war in Gaza.

item.title: The Photographer Who Helped Launch Melania Trump’s Modeling Career Is a Recurring Character in the Epstein Files
item.description: Melania Trump and Antoine Verglas were fixtures of the 1990s fashion circuit—a rarefied ecosystem that Jeffrey Epstein would continue to penetrate long after his conviction.

item.title: Kate Middleton Faces Off In a Game of Rock-Paper-Scissors While Visiting Wales
item.description: The Prince and Princess of Wales traveled to their namesake country in the run-up to its national holiday St. David’s Day, celebrated every March 1.

item.title: How Art Dealers Are Doubling Down on LA—and Winning
item.description: Despite last year’s fires and this year’s New York blizzard cancelling flights, Frieze’s power-agent owner can still bring out the stars.
